{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "purpleKarrot",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "suggested dropping local user_data for a simple function pointer"
    },
    {
      "login": "ryanofsky",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "objected to global logging callback, arguing #34374 enables independent connections and API reversibility burdens downstream callers"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Concept ACK; raised concern about global callback leaking state between unit tests"
    },
    {
      "login": "w0xlt",
      "stance": "support",
      "note": "Approach ACK; suggested RAII wrapper to prevent test leakage"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "c:4024456177",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Prematurely restricts the kernel logging API in a way difficult to reverse without notable simplification",
      "quote": "I think it would be a mistake to limit functionality of the logging/debuging/tracing API prematurely, in a way that seems difficult to reverse and does not seem to provide a noticeable simplification",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "contested",
      "status_note": "ryanofsky pushed back, arguing #34374 removes the singleton rationale and changing caller API later will be disruptive",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:4635220722"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:5827538937",
      "status_by_quote": "My concern is difficultly of updating code written against the API rather than the diff."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3395661504",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Global logging callback leaks state across unit tests if not reset",
      "quote": "Even though this function is scoped to this test, it now enables logging for all the the other unit tests too. Maybe add another call to set the callback to null at the end of the test?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author replied in rc:4036445255",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4036445255"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4036445255",
      "status_by_quote": "Yeah, this seems like the most elegant approach to me. In fact, I think it makes sense to not expose the free logging fu"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3591591675",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Tests installing global callback leak state unless explicitly cleared",
      "quote": "any test that installs the global logging callback now needs to clear it before returning to prevent state leakage into later tests.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author replied in rc:4036445255",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4036445255"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4036445255",
      "status_by_quote": "The `Logger` class should offer all required functionality, in a way that is much harder to abuse. Thank you both for yo"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "c:4022995511",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "Not having separate connections seems simpler, clients can multiplex themselves, and it is pragmatic",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "read",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "c:4792069971",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "",
      "substantive": false,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "author",
      "what": "response to ryanofsky's pushback proposing per-connection filtering instead of making callbacks global",
      "id": "c:5827538937"
    }
  ],
  "notes": "ryanofsky pushed back in c:5827538937, arguing #34374 enables per-connection filtering and explaining API reversibility concerns for callers and bindings, moving c:4024456177 from answered to contested."
}
